| # Configuration Parameters for Checksum Calculation Tool {#configuration-parameters-for-checksum-calculation-tool-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

+----------------------------------+-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Parameter                        | Possible Arguments    | Description                                                                     |
+==================================+=======================+=================================================================================+
| Hexmodx Tool Path                |                       | The path to the hexmodx tool.\                                                  |
|                                  |                       |  \                                                                              |
|                                  |                       | Example: C:/Tools/Hexmodx//14.6.0/bin/HexmodX.cmd                               |
+----------------------------------+-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Hex File(CODESYS MERGED ASW HEX) |                       | The path to the ASW/DS0 software hex file that needs to be flashed to the ECUs\ |
|                                  |                       |  \                                                                              |
|                                  |                       | Example: D:\\Code\\Tool_File\\appl_RC40_large_merge.hex                         |
+----------------------------------+-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
